note: Activity-cycle ephemerides of periodic repeaters. phase = ((MJD - ref_mjd) / P) mod 1. The active window is given in phase. P_err is used to show how uncertain a predicted window is: shift = (cycles since ref_mjd) x P_err.

sources.window_note: Active window ~5.2 d centred on phase 0.5 at 600 MHz (CHIME). Activity is chromatic: higher frequencies peak earlier (e.g. ~3.6 d before the CHIME peak at 4-8 GHz), lower frequencies later.
sources.ref: CHIME/FRB Collaboration 2020, Nature 582, 351; Pleunis et al. 2021, ApJL 911, L3 (P = 16.33 ± 0.12 d, MJD 58369.40, 5.2 d window)
sources.ref_err: P_err = 0.04 d from CHIME bursts 2018-2024 (arXiv:2310.16307). The published CHIME value is ± 0.12 d.

sources.window_note: Active for ~53% of the cycle, centred on phase 0.5 (L band).
sources.ref: Braga et al. 2025, A&A (FRB 20121102A monitoring: updated periodicity in the L band): P = 159.3 ± 0.8 d, MJD 58356.5, 53% duty cycle
sources.ref_err: Earlier values: 157 ± 7 d (Rajwade et al. 2020), 161 ± 5 d (Cruces et al. 2021), 158.1 ± 0.3 d with a 62% window (Nancay, A&A 2025).
